prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original cinematic website hero photograph for a reading site called Along the Way; no text in image.
Create a quiet original widescreen 2.5:1 still, informed by the naturalistic visual atmosphere of the Italian film La meglio gioventù (2003): ordinary lived-in details, restrained colors, subtle film grain, soft photographic edges, warm daylight against cool distant landscape, time passing.
Scene: a modest old Italian room beside a journey, with pale worn plaster taking the LEFT 48 percent of the frame as calm uncluttered space for real website text. On the RIGHT half, a tall wood-framed window stands slightly open, sheer aged linen curtain at its outer edge, showing distant muted green hills and a winding road beneath pale blue overcast sky. Below the window is part of a used wooden writing desk, an open plain notebook and one pencil. No ornate props. A slant of afternoon sunlight lands on the lower wall and desk; left upper wall remains even pale grey-ivory, readable behind dark text.
Camera: eye level, medium-wide 35mm photographic composition, straight architectural lines, believable domestic proportions, slight analogue softness and fine restrained grain. Colors: dusty blue, grey olive, faded warm wood, grey ivory. Human and contemplative, not glossy travel advertising. No people, no written words, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no borders, no film perforations. Avoid HDR, orange-teal grading, glowing haze, artificial vignette, sepia wash, perfect luxury interiors, exaggerated sun rays. The window must stay in the right half and the entire image is one continuous real space.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit this exact room image into a natural late-night version. Keep the camera position, composition, window frame and open shutter geometry, curtain, desk, notebook and chair identical. Change only illumination and time of day: dark muted blue sky with hills barely visible; two or three tiny distant warm house lights along the existing road. The interior is dim olive-charcoal with a very faint warm reflected light on the lower desk, no visible new lamp. Left 48 percent is an evenly dark wall for pale website text. Preserve legible dark details and subtle film grain; emotionally quiet, not horror. No daylight sunlight patch, no starscape, no moon disk, no neon, no added furniture, no text. Same very wide aspect ratio.

One small faded dark red 1990s hatchback travels away from us, far in the middle distance, road leads across the lower foreground. Irregular fields, a few ordinary cypress trees, distant pale house. Soft midday light, calm lived-in countryside, no epic sunset, no idealized postcard beauty. Road visible at small thumbnail sizes.
